an8.52:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ
an8.52:1.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.52:1.3: kati hi nu kho bhante, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhikkhuno vādako sammantītabboti.
an8.52:2.1: aṭṭhahi kho ānanda, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhikkhuno vādako sammannitabbo.
an8.52:2.3: idhānanda, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an8.52:2.5: ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattinī suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso.
an8.52:2.6: kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā,
an8.52:2.7: paṭibalo hoti bhikkhunīsaṅghassa dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ,
an8.52:2.9: na kho panetaṃ bhagavantaṃ uddissa pabbajitāya kāsāyavatthavasanāya garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannapubbo hoti,
an8.52:2.10: vīsativasso vā hoti atirekavīsati vasso vā.
an8.52:2.11: imehi kho ānanda, aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhikkhunovādako sammantitabboti.
